# SEO Content Optimizer

When asked to optimize website content, follow these steps:

1. Understand the primary keyword and search intent.
2. Suggest relevant secondary and LSI keywords.
3. Create an SEO-friendly H1 title.
4. Organize content using H2 and H3 headings.
5. Write an optimized meta title and meta description.
6. Recommend relevant internal linking opportunities.
7. Check keyword placement and natural readability.
8. Suggest image alt text.
9. Identify missing content topics.
10. Provide actionable on-page SEO recommendations.

## Guidelines

- Write naturally for users.
- Avoid keyword stuffing.
- Keep content original and useful.
- Follow Google's SEO best practices.
- Explain recommendations in simple language.
